reasoning: The figure is a regular octagon with 4 alternating shaded triangles. A regular octagon has 8 axes of symmetry (4 passing through midpoints of opposite sides and 4 passing through opposite vertices). In this shaded pattern, the 4 axes passing through the midpoints of opposite sides are reflection axes: two pass through the midpoints of opposite shaded triangles, and two pass through the midpoints of opposite unshaded triangles. The 4 axes passing through vertices are NOT reflection axes because they would map a shaded triangle onto an adjacent unshaded one. Therefore, there are 4 reflection axes in total.
